claim_summary: LineupRL post-trains a VLM time-series captioner with RLOO using a frozen LLM verifier's caption-to-series identification over statistic-matched distractors as a verifiable reward.

claim_evidence.quote: In this work, we propose LineupRL, a reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) pipeline built on caption-to-series identification, a reward that satisfies all three desiderata (Figure 1c).

modules.name: Caption-to-series identification RLVR
modules.scope_reason: R2 LLM: the contribution updates the captioner parameters with reinforcement learning; under R3, the verifier and distractor loop is training-time reward computation rather than a TSK, GTS, or GH runtime module.
rubric_path: R3_1_TSK:no - model-training objective, not a task runtime
R3_2_GTS:no - temporal values are reward inputs, not a reusable temporal-state runtime
R3_3_GH:no - no execution scheduler or general state manager

evidence.quote: We post-train the captioner with reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) (Lambert et al., 2024; Guo et al., 2025).
The reward is caption-to-series identification (upper box of Figure 2b): it scores a caption c written for a series x by whether the frozen verifier R can identify x in C(x) from c alone.

is scored by a frozen LLM verifier that receives the caption and the candidate set C(x) printed as raw numbers and must locate x; the true series is placed at each of the K positions in turn, and the fraction of correct answers gives the reward r(c, x) = λ acc(c, x).

temporal_validity.quote: The split is chronological, so that adjacent windows cut at stride 1 cannot land on both sides of it. Each corpus is one univariate series whose rows are divided 60/20/20 in time order into a training, a validation and a test segment

task_performance.quote: LineupRL has the lowest error in all eight cells, significantly so in seven, the exception being reconstruction on Saugeen where the LLM-as-judge reward ties it.

changes: dimensions: remove Optimization and Evolution and retired Control, Verification, and Feedback labels because LLM modules have no harness dimensions

reconciliation.reason: The existing module is the same contributed RLVR captioner-training mechanism, so its id is retained. The packet supports model-side RL and a caption-to-series verifier reward; the current harness dimension labels and missing LLM route do not match the current rubric.

notes: The primary output is time-series captioning, outside the four named task families; forecasting_prediction and reconstruction are included because the paper evaluates caption-only forecasting and reconstruction.
